in_marathi.name: Utkarshraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Progress, Advancement, Success
in_marathi.long_meaning: Utkarshraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Utkarsh means progress, advancement, and Raj means king or rule. This name suggests a successful and prosperous ruler, a leader who progresses and advances.
